steps.subject: Drupal 10 and the end of its support

paragraphs.text: I'm Sam Carter, a Drupal developer. I work with organisations and agencies that still run older Drupal sites.
Drupal 10 stops getting security updates on 9 December 2026, and after that new holes stay open.
Your site still runs Drupal six, so it was hacked last spring.
Recently I took a Drupal 7 site for Harbour Lane Studio to Drupal 10, with no downtime.
I can write a free one-page upgrade-risk report for Northfield Museum Trust: what is at risk and what an upgrade involves. It is yours to keep. Reply and I will send it.
Sam Carter again, following up on my note last week.
From 9 December 2026, Drupal 10 gets no security updates, so each new hole stays open.
The free one-page upgrade-risk report for Northfield Museum Trust is still yours if you want it.
I tried to call you today about your Drupal site.
The free one-page upgrade-risk report is still on offer. Reply and I will send it.
This is my last note about the Drupal upgrade. If the timing is wrong, no reply is needed.
If it helps later, the free one-page upgrade-risk report stays on offer.

talking_points.text: Drupal 10 stops getting security updates on 9 December 2026.
The site runs Drupal 10.3.1, seen at https://northfield-museum.example/CHANGELOG.txt.
Offer the free one-page upgrade-risk report, theirs to keep.
